# Tell the Stars, in full

{{ site.data.meta.motto }}

## Scripts

Writing has a family tree. Each script below: its name [id]; its kind, whether it can be read (living, read, partly read, unread), when and where; its descent, where a number in brackets is how sure a join is, from 0 to 1; its word for name where it can be typed; a note; and the questions it leaves open.
{% for s in site.data.scripts %}
### {{ s[1].name }} [{{ s[0] }}]
{{ s[1].kind }} · {{ s[1].status }} · {{ s[1].when }}{% if s[1].place %} · {{ s[1].place }}{% endif %}
descent: {{ s[1].name }}{% assign node = s[1] %}{% for i in (1..24) %}{% if node.parent %}{% assign up = site.data.scripts[node.parent] %} ←{% if node.certainty %} [{{ node.certainty }}]{% endif %} {{ up.name | default: node.parent }}{% assign node = up %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}
{% for k in s[1].links %}link: {{ k.kind }} {{ k.to }}{% if k.certainty %} [{{ k.certainty }}]{% endif %}
{% endfor %}{% if s[1].sample %}name: {{ s[1].sample.text }} ({{ s[1].sample.says }})
{% endif %}{{ s[1].note | strip }}
{% for q in s[1].open %}open: {{ q }}
{% endfor %}{% endfor %}

## Letters

It starts with letters. Each set of letters below belongs to a script above. For each letter, as far as they are known: its old picture, what its name means, its tone class and sounds, its value, its place in Sefer Yetzirah, the Sanskrit letter it continues or the Greek and Latin letters it became, the letters it is easily taken for, and a note.
{% for set in site.data.letters %}
{% assign sid = set[0] %}### The letters of {{ site.data.scripts[sid].name | default: sid }} [{{ sid }}]
{% for l in set[1] %}
#### {{ l[1].char }}{% if l[1].final %} {{ l[1].final }}{% endif %} {{ l[1].name }}{% if l[1].name_heb %} ({{ l[1].name_heb }}){% endif %}{% if l[1].name_native %} ({{ l[1].name_native }}){% endif %} [{{ l[0] }}]
{% capture facts %}{% if l[1].picture %} · picture: {{ l[1].picture }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].meaning %} · meaning: {{ l[1].meaning }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].class %} · class: {{ l[1].class }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].sound %} · sound: {{ l[1].sound }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].ipa %} · IPA: /{{ l[1].ipa }}/{% endif %}{% if l[1].final_sound %} · final: {{ l[1].final_sound }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].value %} · value: {{ l[1].value }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].sefer_yetzirah %} · Sefer Yetzirah: {{ l[1].sefer_yetzirah }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].sanskrit %} · Sanskrit: {{ l[1].sanskrit }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].greek %} · Greek: {{ l[1].greek }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].latin %} · Latin: {{ l[1].latin }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].obsolete %} · no longer used{% endif %}{% endcapture %}{{ facts | remove_first: " · " }}
{% for n in l[1].near %}near {{ n.char }}: {{ n.note }}
{% endfor %}{% if l[1].note %}{{ l[1].note | strip }}
{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endfor %}

## Names

Each leaf below: name, native form [id], meaning; then its parent and how it is joined, the verse, its roots, and its note. Roots are Hebrew consonants; יה is Yah and אל is El. Identity links carry a certainty when the sameness is uncertain.
{% for g in site.data.groves %}

{{ g.heading }} ({{ g.ref }})

{{ l[1].gloss }}
{% if l[1].parent %}{{ l[1].kind }} · {{ l[1].parent }}{% endif %}{% if l[1].ref %} · {{ l[1].ref }}{% endif %}

{% endif %}{% if l[1].links %}links: {% for k in l[1].links %}{{ k.kind }} {{ k.to }}{% if k.certainty %} (certainty {{ k.certainty }}){% endif %}{% unless forloop.last %}; {% endunless %}{% endfor %}
{% endif %}{% for n in l[1].naming %}naming: "{{ n.text }}" ({{ n.ref }})
